hero.subtitle: Realism, Blackwork, Color, and Fine Line. Designs shaped to every anatomy, fusing technical precision with artistic rawness.

filosofia.title: The Art of the Permanent Mark
filosofia.body: I work across realism, blackwork, color and fine line. My philosophy rests on one principle: a tattoo is not a static image, but a piece of body architecture that has to live with the movement and essence of whoever carries it.
filosofia.card1_body: Reading muscular flow so the design settles into the body organically.
filosofia.card2_body: Surgical-grade standards and top-tier materials for your safety.
filosofia.card3_body: A deep discovery process that turns your idea into a timeless piece.

process.title: The Path of the Ink
process.step1_body: An opening conversation to understand your vision, anatomy and expectations. We define style, scale and technical placement together.
process.step2_body: The piece is created exclusively for you. Every line is adjusted digitally over your real anatomy for a perfect fit.
process.step3_body: Execution with technical precision in a clinical-grade studio, with full guidance through the post-session healing protocol.
